title: The console's frame works from the keyboard and reads correctly to a screen reader

arg.name: landmarks
arg.script: (() => { const h1 = document.querySelectorAll('main h1').length; if (h1 !== 1) throw new Error(`${h1} h1 in main`); if (!document.querySelector("nav[aria-label='Console']")) throw new Error('the sidebar is not a named landmark'); return document.title; })()

arg.name: first_tab
arg.script: (() => { const t = document.activeElement.innerText; if (t !== 'Skip to content') throw new Error(`the first Tab reached: ${t}`); return t; })()

arg.name: skipped_to
arg.script: (() => { if (document.activeElement.tagName !== 'MAIN') throw new Error(`focus is on ${document.activeElement.tagName}`); return 'main'; })()

arg.name: sort_by_key
arg.script: (async () => { const th = [...document.querySelectorAll('th[aria-sort]')].find((h) => h.innerText.trim() === 'status'); if (!th) throw new Error('no sortable status header'); const before = th.getAttribute('aria-sort'); th.querySelector('button').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const after = th.getAttribute('aria-sort'); if (before !== 'none' || after !== 'ascending') throw new Error(`${before} -> ${after}`); return after; })()

arg.name: row_link
arg.script: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('a[data-row-link]'); if (!a.getAttribute('href').includes('/projects/')) throw new Error(a.getAttribute('href')); return a.innerText; })()
